public_payload.normalized_proposition: Within 5 years, a substantial fraction of AI effort will look beyond the current LLM-focused approaches.

statement.excerpt: So I don’t think we will waste more than 5 years before a substantial fraction of AI effort is looking outside the limited streetlight that currently are sucking up so much mental energy.
statement.document_title: AGI will not happen in your lifetime. Or will it?

from_speaker: a substantial fraction of AI effort
our_interpretation: The five-year deadline is January 22, 2028, measured from publication.
The surrounding discussion identifies the streetlight as contemporary LLM-centered approaches and motivates alternatives addressing semantics, causality, commonsense reasoning, and integration.
The plain reading requires a material share of field-wide research effort, not merely the existence of alternative projects.
Hybrid systems can qualify when they materially pursue these alternatives; using an LLM does not automatically disqualify them.
Substantial need not mean a majority. No numerical cutoff or preferred measure of effort is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: By January 22, 2028, representative research-output, staffing, or funding records establish an unambiguously substantial share of AI effort pursuing approaches beyond the contemporary LLM-centered focus.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative records through the deadline show that such work remains marginal under reasonable measures and classifications of AI effort.
